row.proto: float Sess_VirtualPerformance_EstimateSpeedAtLapFraction(void *self, void *entrant, float lap_fraction, void *a4, uint32_t a5, uint32_t a6, uint32_t a7)
row.notes: Wraps lap_fraction into 0..1, converts it to a track distance (vcall +0x188, track index at entrant+0x04), then samples Sess_VirtualPerformance_EvalBlocksAtDistance at distance-3, distance and distance+3 (wrapped by lap length from +0xa0 table, stride 0x48) and returns the average of 3/dt before and 3/dt after, i.e. a central-difference speed estimate. Returns 0 if no data is loaded.
